dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Long-standing congenital right oculomotor nerve palsy due to congenital cranial dysinnervation, with aberrant parasympathetic regeneration causing spontaneous cyclic pupillary spasms

ALTERNATIVE 1: Chronic traumatic right oculomotor nerve palsy with aberrant regeneration

ALTERNATIVE 2: Chronic idiopathic pupil-involving right oculomotor nerve palsy

ALTERNATIVE 3: Chronic microvascular right oculomotor nerve palsy with residual extraocular-muscle atrophy
